Program

GZCLP

Two full-body days: one heavy T1 lift, one volume T2 lift, and high-rep T3 accessories.

  • Biceps
  • Calves
  • Chest
  • Forearms
  • Glutes
  • Hamstrings
  • Lats
  • Lower Back
  • Middle Back
  • Quadriceps
  • Shoulders
  • Traps
  • Triceps

The schedule

Two full-body days a week. Every day has one heavy Tier 1 lift (5 × 3+), one Tier 2 volume lift (3 × 10), and Tier 3 accessories (3 × 15+). Squat leads Day 1 and overhead press leads Day 2.

How progression works

Add 5-10 lb to T1 and T2 lifts each session while you hit your reps; add weight to T3 accessories when the last set hits 25+ reps. Miss reps, and the tier drops to a new rep scheme at a slightly lower weight.

The days

  • Day 1

    One heavy lift, one volume lift, and accessories.

  • Day 2

    Press heavy, pull for volume, row for balance.
